final: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN element IN ('cl', 'c') THEN 1 END) = 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT element) = 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as has_both FROM (SELECT a1.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' UNION ALL SELECT a2.element FROM connected c JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8')
